To get us started, which sports or physical activities have been the primary focus of your life so far?
Options: [Team sports (e.g., soccer, basketball, volleyball) | Individual endurance (e.g., running, swimming, cycling) | Technical or precision sports (e.g., gymnastics, climbing) | I'm still exploring and haven't specialized yet]
Technical or precision sports (e.g., gymnastics, climbing)

How many years have you been training in these disciplines, and do you feel your strength lies more in the explosive power required for rapid movements, or the sustained endurance needed for longer sessions?
Options: [Mostly explosive power and short bursts | More sustained endurance and pacing | A balanced mix of both]
Mostly explosive power and short bursts

As you envision yourself competing at the highest level at age 22, how do you see your approach to technical precision evolving from the rapid, explosive bursts you master today?
Options: [Refining explosive power for greater technical consistency | Integrating more endurance to sustain intensity through longer rounds | Mastering even more complex, high-difficulty maneuvers]
Mastering even more complex, high-difficulty maneuvers

While your current journey is rooted in the high-intensity, explosive precision of technical sports, this profile harnesses that same capacity for rapid acceleration and converts it into the relentless, sustained tempo required for high-performance cycling. Your focus on mastering complex, high-difficulty maneuvers translates beautifully here into the tactical brilliance needed to navigate a peloton or manage a race-winning breakaway.

By the time you reach the starting line in 2032, the explosive bursts you favor will have evolved into a formidable weapon, allowing you to dominate technical climbs and decisive surges. This pathway honors your technical roots while challenging you to push that precision into an endurance-based arena. You aren't just riding; you are applying the same analytical, movement-based mindset you developed in your younger years to command the road with surgical grace.

The path of the Mat Technician is built for someone who views sport as a puzzle of leverage and geometry. At 164cm, your compact build provides a low center of gravity and mechanical advantages that are essential for controlling an opponent or mastering heavy, precise resistance movements. Your dedication to learning complex, high-difficulty maneuvers is the perfect fuel for this discipline; success here is won by those who can execute flawless technique under extreme pressure.

Looking toward The 2032 Games, this profile positions you as a tactician who can outmaneuver the opposition through superior positioning and explosive, calculated power. Where others rely on brute force, you will be defined by your ability to read the moment and apply your force with pinpoint accuracy. This is a journey that celebrates your background in precision sport, proving that at age 22, your greatest strength lies in the marriage of your explosive intensity and your unwavering commitment to technical perfection.
